text: Visitors have raised concerns about the requirement to purchase tickets online well in advance, with no option to buy tickets at the library, leading to frustration for those who travel without prior arrangements. Parking and traffic flow have been criticized for narrow lanes, limited camper parking, and poor signage, contributing to a difficult arrival experience. Some visitors noted long lines and a lack of communication about security procedures and ticket availability at the parking lot. Despite these issues, many reviews mention the interactive exhibits and architecture positively, but crowding and timed entry remain points of contention. The library should consider addressing ticketing flexibility and improving parking and visitor information to enhance the overall experience.

windows.60: Visitors have frequently noted issues with the timed entry system, particularly the requirement to purchase tickets online well in advance, which has led to frustration and some arriving without tickets after traveling long distances. Parking and traffic flow around the library have also been criticized for poor design, including narrow lanes and limited camper parking, with inadequate signage and communication about security and ticketing at the lot. Several reviews mention long lines and crowding, especially at security checkpoints, and a lack of restrooms outside while waiting. While many visitors engage with the interactive exhibits and comment on the architecture, concerns about limited admission and the overall visitor experience have been raised in multiple critical reviews.
windows.90: Recent visitor reviews of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library show ongoing issues with the timed entry ticketing system, which requires advance online purchase and has led to frustration for those arriving without tickets. Parking and traffic flow around the site were frequently criticized for being poorly designed and difficult to navigate, especially for larger vehicles. Some visitors noted long lines and inadequate communication about security procedures and ticket availability upon arrival. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, concerns about crowding and limited admission were also mentioned. Staff interactions received some positive remarks, but overall, operational and logistical challenges were the main points needing attention.
